plugins.name: silcrow
plugins.description: Silcrow — Agency Helper. Scaffold a hierarchical agency: a disciplined multi-agent organization with ADR decision tracking, async-auditor registrar, canonical/operational artifact discipline, and multi-unit support. Three skills: silcrow-init, silcrow-add-unit, silcrow-update.

plugins.name: operbe
plugins.description: operbe, the operations and behaviors method. For projects with a server and front ends: one list of operations every front end uses, one list of behaviors every UI is built from and checked against, and optionally a list of client actions that a command palette, shortcuts and an assistant use to work a UI.

plugins.name: stop-safe
plugins.description: stop-safe, a way of designing software in which nothing has to stay running. Four kinds of thing (history, work, caches, sessions), eight statements, and one test run four ways.
